A heartbreak anthem that struck a chord with millions Sohnea by Miss Pooja feat. Millind Gaba — out on Speed Records.
Sung by the Queen of Punjabi music Miss Pooja with Millind Gaba, lyrics by Happy Raikoti and music by MG, Sohnea became one of the biggest emotional Punjabi hits — a soulful song of love and longing. Starring Piyush Sahdev. Feel every word.
Song Credits
Song - Sohnea
Starring - Piyush Sahdev
Singer – Miss Pooja Feat. Millind Gaba
Lyrics – Happy Raikoti
Music – MG
